notes: Registration input, not a run input: every trade of the two 15-minute series (KXBTC15M, KXETH15M) from the kalshi_history pack (ADR-0236): trade_id, ticker, created_time, yes_price (dollars), count (contracts) and taker_side. Pulled PER MARKET: each market is asked of the archive that owns each period of its life (/historical/trades before the venue's trades_created_ts cutoff, /markets/trades from it), so a market that straddles the cutoff is asked of both and a trade seen by both is stored once. The pair has 96 markets a day each, so the pull is about 192 request chains a day of history: the cheaper family, run it first. Trades are dated at created_time and a trade created after the pull's capture instant is not emitted (the next pull asks again), so nothing is future-dated. A resumed pull skips markets that closed at or before the cursor and asks for trades from the cursor's whole second; statuses are the pack default [settled, closed, open] for the reason given in source-kalshi-history-candles-hourly-btc.json. A trade is an event of the market's life, not a quote: a feature at decision time I may use only trades with created_time before I. One source per family because a failed pull commits nothing. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi-history-trades-15m --catalog-source kalshi-history-trades-15m --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.kalshi_history:KalshiHistoryConnector --config @configs/source-kalshi-history-trades-15m.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source kalshi-history-trades-15m --stream trades --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-kalshi-history-trades.json.
